_comment: This is a reference copy of the matching rules baked into worker.js (see SERVICES and matchServices()). Editing this file alone does NOT change behavior — it's documentation of the logic. Update worker.js if you change the rules.

Antenna.note: Only matches when the broadcast name IS the bare network (e.g. 'CBS'). Does NOT match 'CBS via Paramount+' or similar bundled strings.

CBS.warning: ESPN does not identify Boise's regional CBS game; the card labels this option as unconfirmed.

Paramount+.note: Matches any broadcast string containing 'Paramount+' (Champions League, NWSL, some NFL simulcasts) UNLESS it also mentions Showtime, which is not part of the Essential/Basic plan. Plain 'CBS' does NOT count as Paramount+ — see Antenna.

Peacock.note: Covers Peacock-exclusive and Peacock/NBC simulcast windows: Premier League, Big Ten, Sunday Night Football simulcast, WNBA on Peacock, some NBA.

Prime Video.note: National/general Prime Video labels match normally. 'Prime Video (Local)' only matches configured home teams whose local stream is confirmed available in the user's region. Dallas Stars home-market broadcasts are excluded; Seattle Kraken is included based on user confirmation.

MLB.TV.note: Only matches broadcasts ESPN explicitly labels MLB.TV. Availability may be affected by MLB.TV subscription requirements and blackout restrictions.

YouTube.note: Free live streams only (e.g. MLB free game of the week when explicitly broadcast as YouTube). No YouTube TV / cable channels.

Apple TV.note: Matches the exact ESPN broadcast string observed for an MLS game. No separate 'MLS Season Pass' string was observed; the feed does not confirm which Apple subscription tier grants access.

Tubi.note: Free service filter; it only matches when ESPN explicitly includes Tubi in a broadcast name. No Tubi labels were found in recent MLB/NHL samples.

_toggle_behavior.default: All services are enabled unless a browser-local preference says otherwise.
_toggle_behavior.persistence: Enabled service IDs are stored in localStorage; if browser storage is unavailable, toggles still work until the page is closed.
_toggle_behavior.recompute: The browser recomputes game buckets immediately after a toggle and every 60 seconds. ESPN data is fetched every 10 minutes.
_toggle_behavior.api: The existing buckets are computed with all services enabled. The games array includes every non-finished game today, plus finished Boise State games so they remain pinned; scores includes all events today, including finished games. No toggle state is stored on the server.

_favorites_and_scores.scores_view: Groups every event on the current Boise-local date by sport, including finished scores, live events, and future starts. It does not depend on which services are enabled.
_favorites_and_scores.configuration: Use the star button beside a team in either dashboard view to add or remove it. Changes are saved in browser-local storage; these teams are defaults before the first saved preference.

_not_watchable_details.display: Games with no enabled service show the distinct broadcast/network names ESPN listed, even if the service is not one the user owns.
_not_watchable_details.caveat: A listed broadcast is informational only and does not mean the user can access it. If ESPN supplies no broadcast names, the dashboard says so.

_wwe_nxt.schedule: The CW's official schedule lists WWE NXT Tuesday, October 27, 2026, from 8-10 PM ET; the official show page also lists the October 20 episode. The worker adds a recurring Tuesday 8 PM ET scheduled-show entry with the CW antenna match.
_wwe_nxt.limitation: This is a schedule reminder, not match-card, live-score, or result coverage.

_sports_scope.policy: The worker uses a curated ESPN scoreboard league allowlist rather than discovering every ESPN sport; unrelated sports such as motocross are not included automatically.
_sports_scope.volleyball: ESPN's men's and women's college-volleyball scoreboard endpoints are included; other volleyball leagues are not included.
_sports_scope.wrestling: TheSportsDB's Fighting events calendar returned wrestling events (including AEW, NJPW, and RevPro), but the sampled events did not include TV/broadcast data. It is not currently used because reliable service matching would not be possible.

_track_and_field.note: ESPN track-and-field scoreboard routes tested returned HTTP 400. TheSportsDB's Athletics daily calendar returned no events on the date checked, so no reliable feed has been verified or added.

_local_idaho_sports.boise_state: Existing ESPN feeds cover football (groups=80 FBS query), men's and women's basketball, and women's college volleyball. Boise State was not found in the tested men's college-volleyball feed. Soccer, beach volleyball, and track-and-field scoreboard routes were not usable.
_local_idaho_sports.athletic_club_boise: TheSportsDB has an AC Boise team record, but the upcoming-events endpoint checked returned no events. No schedule feed is integrated.
_local_idaho_sports.idaho_steelheads: TheSportsDB has a team record and next-events endpoint, but it returned rate limiting during verification. No dependable feed is integrated.
_local_idaho_sports.boise_hawks: No team record was found in the TheSportsDB search, and no verified schedule feed is integrated.
_local_idaho_sports.favorite_behavior: These team names are included in the default favorites so their cards will be highlighted if they appear in an integrated feed. Favorites do not create schedule data.

_fgc_tournaments.source: Optional start.gg GraphQL API integration; requires a user-created API token stored in local .dev.vars as STARTGG_API_TOKEN (or as a Cloudflare Worker secret when deployed).
_fgc_tournaments.coverage: Looks for tournaments in the next 7 days and includes recognized Smash and fighting-game events with a start.gg tournament link. Both views offer All, Smash, Other FGC, and Streams only filters; filters persist in local storage. Events are grouped by Boise-local Today, Tomorrow, and collapsed later-this-week groups. Displays tournament-level stream names/platforms if supplied.
_fgc_tournaments.limitations: Depends on organizer listings; start.gg does not provide a reliable live/on-air state or match-score feed. An event within its schedule window is not confirmed live. Stream names/platforms are separate from TV-service matching/toggle rules and do not guarantee the stream is live or available. If the token is missing or the API is unavailable, ESPN dashboard data remains available.

_local_cbs.note: ESPN reports CBS NFL broadcasts as national and does not identify Boise affiliate KBOI's regional game. 506 Sports listings show regional assignments in map images without a structured market-to-game mapping, so CBS network matches are not proof the game is available locally.
